caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background. The chair features a light brown wooden frame with a tall backrest consisting of four horizontal slats, each with a symmetrical, subtly curved design and a small central decorative oval. The seat of the chair is square-shaped and upholstered in a light pinkish-red fabric with a faint, intricate pattern. The legs of the chair are straight and sturdy, with additional horizontal support bars connecting them at the front and sides near the base. The composition is symmetrical, with the entire chair shown in frontal view and no other objects or details present in the image.
title: Ladderback Chair
